applicabilityBasis.summary: sreUSD is an ERC-4626 savings-vault share, not the underlying reUSD stablecoin. Each share redeems for a changing amount of reUSD as yield accrues, rather than a fixed amount of monetary value. It records a variable savings position and is not designed as the fixed-value payment or settlement token defined by GENIUS Act Section 2(22).

genius.notes: Assessment is specific to the appreciating vault-share token, not its underlying stablecoin or protocol. It is not an authorization claim, a legal securities determination, or a finding about compliance of the parent. No corporate issuer identity is inferred from developer or governance labels.
